item_01.title: Team Deployment
item_01.text: At least 2 certified specialists on-site. Seamless teamwork in pairs for maximum efficiency and speed.

item_03.text: We operate completely legally. We lock in the final cost before cleaning starts and provide a receipt.

mobile_team.title: MOBILE CLEANING CREW
mobile_team.description: Everything needed arrives with us. Each vehicle is a fully equipped workstation with professional machinery and certified eco-chemicals.

equipment.title: PROFESSIONAL EQUIPMENT

chemicals.title: COMPLETE CHEMICAL KIT

inventory.title: ALL REQUIRED INVENTORY

pricelist.description: Transparent pricing with no hidden fees. Fixed cost locked in the contract before cleaning starts.
